# NextPage Addons

> Community directory of book catalogs (addons) for NextPage. Search, filter, and open any addon for details.

## Routes

## Catalog

Complete machine-readable catalog: https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/catalog.json

- Faded Page — Canadian public-domain books, digitized by volunteers. — https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/catalogo/faded-page
- Gutendex — Over 70,000 free ebooks from Project Gutenberg, with search and full details. — https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/catalogo/gutendex
- LibriVox — Free volunteer-narrated audiobooks in several languages. — https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/catalogo/librivox
- Open Library — Millions of records and covers from the Internet Archive open library. — https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/catalogo/openlibrary
- Standard Ebooks — Carefully produced, well-formatted public-domain classics, in English. — https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/catalogo/standard-ebooks
- Wikisource — Free Spanish source texts maintained by the Wikimedia community. — https://nextpage-addons.jcamachomolina503.workers.dev/catalogo/wikisource

## Contribute

Propose a new addon at https://github.com/JuanCamacho198/NEXTPAGE (see the submit page).
